nodes.description: Mapping address=>uint256 tracking ETH invested per user; read in getProfit/getInvested and written in investETH/reinvestProfit.
Mapping address=>uint256 storing the last investment timestamp used to compute profit accrual; written with now in investETH/withdraw/reinvestProfit.
Mapping address=>uint256 holding accrued affiliate commission; credited in investETH, read/zeroed in withdrawAffiliateCommision.
Hardcoded developer address receiving commission share; used as a comparison and mapping key in investETH.
Hardcoded promoter address receiving commission share; used as a comparison and mapping key in investETH.
Payable entry point: requires msg.value>=0.5 ether, pays accrued profit via msg.sender.transfer, splits 5% commissions and updates investedETH/lastInvest.
Public function that computes profit via getProfit(msg.sender), requires profit>0, resets lastInvest and transfers profit to msg.sender.
View wrapper returning getProfit(msg.sender) for the caller.
View function computing (now - lastInvest[customer]) * investedETH[customer] / 345600 using SafeMath; depends on block.timestamp.
Public function that capitalizes accrued profit back into investedETH[msg.sender] and refreshes lastInvest.
View function returning affiliateCommision[msg.sender].
Public function zeroing affiliateCommision[msg.sender] and transferring the amount to msg.sender.
View function returning investedETH[msg.sender].
View function returning the contract balance this.balance.
Private pure helper returning the smaller of two uint256 values.
Private pure helper returning the larger of two uint256 values.
Library multiplication with overflow assertion.
Library integer division.
Library subtraction asserting b<=a to prevent underflow.
Library addition asserting c>=a to prevent overflow.
Caller-controlled address used as accounting key and as the recipient of all ETH transfers.
Block timestamp (now) used for profit accrual and lastInvest bookkeeping.
msg.sender.transfer(profit) external value call inside investETH executed before full state finalization.
msg.sender.transfer(profit) external value call inside withdraw.
msg.sender.transfer(commision) external value call inside withdrawAffiliateCommision.
Referral address parameter of investETH used as key into affiliateCommision.
Customer address parameter of getProfit used to index lastInvest and investedETH.
Local variable holding getProfit(msg.sender) inside investETH, later transferred.
Local variable receiving msg.value in investETH.
Local variable equal to amount/20 creditied to affiliate/dev/promoter in investETH.
Local variable holding computed profit in withdraw, later transferred.
Local variable now - lastInvest[customer] inside getProfit.
Local variable holding profit that is compounded into investedETH in reinvestProfit.
Local variable holding affiliateCommision[msg.sender] before it is zeroed and transferred.

normalization_plan.reason: The referral parameter has no independent semantics outside the commission branch of investETH.
The customer parameter is only an internal indexing helper for getProfit.
The profit local is a transient value inside investETH feeding the payout transfer.
The amount local is just the captured msg.value of investETH.
The commission local is an intermediate value used only inside investETH.
The profit local is a transient computation inside withdraw.
secondsPassed is an internal computation of the getProfit accrual formula.
The profit local exists only to be compounded inside reinvestProfit.
The commission local is a transient balance snapshot inside withdrawAffiliateCommision.
